component.name: RustTavern
component.summary: The classic SillyTavern, as a self-hosted HTTP server

description.p: RustTavern serves the SillyTavern experience as a self-hosted HTTP server with a Rust backend while preserving compatibility with the upstream frontend and ecosystem.
It provides local data storage, character and chat management, and Chat Completion integrations without requiring a Node.js runtime.
